description_en: This API is used to retrieve the end-to-end user management event List
description_zh: 本接口用于获取端对端用户事件列表
kebab_example: aliyun rtc describe-end-point-event-list --app-id testappid --channel-id testid --created-ts 1614936817 --destroyed-ts 1614936817 --user-id-list testuserid1,testuserid2 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeEndPointEventList

parameters.help_en: Start Time of the event query time range. This time must not be earlier than the actual channel Creation Time and must not be earlier than 30 days ago. It is represented as a UNIX timestamp in seconds
parameters.help_zh: 事件查询时间区间的开始时间，该时间不得早于频道实际的创建时间，不得早于30天之前。使用UNIX时间戳表示，单位：秒
parameters.name: created_ts

parameters.help_en: End time of the event query time range. This time must not be later than the channel release time. It is represented as a UNIX timestamp in seconds. If this parameter is empty, the current time is used
parameters.help_zh: 事件查询时间区间的结束时间，该时间不得晚于频道释放时间。使用UNIX时间戳表示，单位：秒。参数为空，表示获取当前时间
parameters.name: destroyed_ts

parameters.help_en: List of User IDs, separated by commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 用户ID列表，多个用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: user_id_list
